description: Defines the NetworkQualitiesPrefsManager class responsible for managing network quality preferences, including reading, writing, and observing network quality data, with an embedded PrefDelegate interface for persistence.

classes.name: NetworkQualitiesPrefsManager
classes.description: Manages network quality preferences, including initialization, shutdown, clearing prefs, and observing network quality cache changes.

classes.name: NetworkQualitiesPrefsManager::PrefDelegate
classes.description: Interface for persistence operations related to network quality preferences, requiring implementation of setting and getting dictionary values.

methods.name: NetworkQualitiesPrefsManager
methods.description: Constructor that takes ownership of a PrefDelegate instance.

methods.name: InitializeOnNetworkThread
methods.description: Initializes the manager on the network thread after prefs are ready.

methods.name: ForceReadPrefsForTesting
methods.description: Reads and parses prefs into a map for testing purposes.

methods.name: OnChangeInCachedNetworkQuality
methods.description: Callback invoked when cached network quality changes.
